description: Example Cloudflare WAF custom rules + rate limits for Unhinted Marketing. Import via Dashboard → Security → WAF, or Terraform cloudflare_ruleset. Adjust hostnames and thresholds for your deployment.

rules.name: Bypass cache — session SSE
rules.description: Ensure /api/sessions/*/events is never cached at edge. Prefer Cache Rules (see docs/infra/cloudflare.md); this documents the path pattern.

rules.name: Rate limit — auth register/login/refresh
rules.description: Edge protection for auth endpoints; complements in-memory AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_*.

rules.name: Block missing Turnstile on auth (optional)
rules.description: When Turnstile is enabled, require cf-turnstile-response header on auth POSTs. Enable only after frontend ships Turnstile widget and TURNSTILE_ENABLED=true on API.
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path matches "^/api/auth/(register|login)$" and http.request.method eq "POST" and not http.request.headers["cf-turnstile-response"][0] ne "")
